CustomField.description: The bundle this component belongs to. Product2 accepts neither master-detail children nor cascade/restrict lookups, so this cannot be a required lookup: emptiness is enforced by the Bundle_Required validation rule, and Spread_Total__c on the bundle is maintained by BundleComponentTriggerHandler rather than a roll-up summary.
